upcoming_events.title: Bloody Mary Festival
upcoming_events.description: Saturday, 11 AM–2 PM, unlimited Bloody Mary tastings from Emerald Coast restaurants and bars, plus live music, SEC football on the big screen and lawn games · $65 advance, $75 at the door, 21+ · benefits Habitat for Humanity of Walton County · 25-min drive west.

upcoming_events.title: Harvest Wine & Food Festival
upcoming_events.description: 10th annual · four days in WaterColor — Celebrity Winemaker Dinners Thursday, Harvest After Dark Friday, the Grand Tasting Saturday Oct 17 in Cerulean Park (1–4 PM), and a Festival Brunch Sunday · benefits DCWAF children's charities · 10-min drive west

upcoming_events.title: Baytowne Beer Festival
upcoming_events.description: 18th annual · Friday night's Backyard Bash (6–8 PM) kicks off tailgate-style with bourbon and bonfires under the stars; Saturday brings a 1–2 PM VIP hour followed by the Grand Craft Beer Tasting, 2–5 PM, sampling from 200-plus craft beers · advance tickets recommended · 25-min drive west

upcoming_events.title: Halloweener Derby & Costume Contest
upcoming_events.description: Saturday Oct 24, 10 AM–2 PM at the Seaside Amphitheater · dachshund races down Central Square and an all-breeds costume contest · free to watch, bring the dog and a camera · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Seeing Red Wine Festival
upcoming_events.description: 34 years running · a vintners dinner at Bud & Alley's, the Al Fresco Reserve Tasting, Battle of the Somms, the Grand Tasting in Central Square, and a Celebration of Bubbles brunch · benefits DCWAF · sold out — join the waitlist at seasideseeingred.com · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Rosemary Beach Uncorked
upcoming_events.description: 15th annual · Saturday Nov 14, 2026, 1–4 PM on Barrett Square · wines poured by vintners from around the world alongside dishes from ten Rosemary Beach restaurants, with live music as you stroll the cobblestone streets · $225 general admission, $350 VIP · 15-min drive east

upcoming_events.title: Morning Vinyasa Yoga
upcoming_events.description: Through Oct 31 · Daily 8:30 AM · Every morning at 8:30 AM on the pavilion overlooking the Gulf, weather permitting · no preregistration, $25 drop-in by cash, check, or Venmo · bring a mat or towel and water · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Sounds of Seaside Concert Series
upcoming_events.description: Through Oct 28 · Wed 5–7 PM · Free Wednesday-evening concerts on the Seaside Amphitheater lawn, 5–7 PM, running weekly through Oct 28 · a different act each week, free and open to all ages · bring blankets and chairs, snacks and drinks welcome · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Central Square Cinema
upcoming_events.description: Through Oct 30 · Fri 8 PM · Free family movies on the big screen at the Seaside Amphitheater, Fridays at 8 PM — Hoppers (Oct 9), Hotel Transylvania (Oct 16), Coco (Oct 23), and a Halloween feature (Oct 30) · bring a blanket and the kids · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Seaside Farmers Market
upcoming_events.description: Year-Round · Sat 9–1 · Saturdays year-round, 9 AM–1 PM at the Seaside Amphitheater, with a second Tuesday market added each June and July · local growers, artisan cheeses and breads, craft chefs, and live acoustic music · 5-min walk or drive

Both cottages, Fri Nov 13 – Sun 15. Three nights.

Six bedrooms, four baths, sixteen people — side by side on the same quiet lane in Seagrove, one address to give everyone.

Pelayo public beach access is a 3-minute walk straight across Scenic 30A, in time for the light going gold.

Book direct — link in bio.

Bloody Mary Festival at The Market Shops, Sat Oct 10 — 11 AM to 2 PM, tastings from Emerald Coast restaurants, live music, SEC football on the big screen. 21+, and about 25 minutes west.

If a quieter stretch suits you better, Blue Moon has Mon Oct 19 – Wed 21 open. Three king bedrooms, a fireplace, and the kind of evening where nobody checks the time.

Book direct — link in bio.
